next.reason: The 1985 rule only makes the relative RESERVE clause the sequential one. 2023 writes one RESERVE clause (12.4.5.14, 'the number of input-output areas allocated is equal to the value of integer-1', §2023:12.4.5.14.3 GR1) into both the relative format (§2023:12.4.5.2 SR9 'Format 2 shall be specified only for a relative file') and the sequential format (§2023:12.4.5.2 SR11), so the sameness holds; the clause's own content is carried by the sequential RESERVE rule's record.
